title: Preserve 'only' constraint in record_decision capture hint
context: Hunch rules documentation across multiple files (Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot) needed restructuring and clarification. During this update, precision of the `record_decision` capture token guidance was at stake. Touches invariant(s): con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Retain the word 'only' in the `record_decision` capture token hint rather than removing or rewriting it, ensuring the guidance accurately conveys the constraint on when this MCP tool should be invoked.
consequences: Documentation precisely communicates the limited scope of `record_decision` usage
Developers understand it is not a catch-all record tool but has specific applicability rules
Consistency maintained across Cursor, Windsurf, and Copilot instruction contexts
alternatives_rejected: Omitting 'only' — would weaken precision and leave scope ambiguous
Rewriting the hint with different phrasing — alternative wording tested was less clear about the constraint
